consequences: Client participation works on trusted packs without an LLM. Production content service, editorial review and server signing deployment remain a separate explicit gate. No new production private signing key was introduced by this change.
context: WorldOps owns signed authored transitions. The desktop lacked an actual choice/task/timeline bridge and the default composition remains local_split_development.
decision: Use typed main-window Gateway actions with identity checks, current signature and event CAS, deterministic authored choices and atomic receipt/task/outbox transaction. Show real memory candidate results. Label local content previews; authored lantern source is reviewable and not an official published release.
title: Desktop authored narrative participation v1
